title: SG-5.4.1 planPreload and resolveTextureKey engine functions
summary: Add planPreload and resolveTextureKey as importable engine functions in game/src/engine.
description: Context: a search of game/ for planPreload and resolveTextureKey returns nothing. The manifest loader (game/src/assets/loaders/manifestLoader.ts) already exports FALLBACK_ASSET_ID and checkAssetRefs. Desired behavior: a pure planPreload dedupes the asset ids a scene references and reports unknown references, and a pure resolveTextureKey returns the fallback asset id for unknown ids. Expected result: both functions are importable from game/src/engine. Why: the asset preload step (SG-5.4) needs them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene that references the same asset id more than once, when planPreload runs, then each known id appears once in the plan.
Given a scene that references an id that is not in the manifest, when planPreload runs, then that id is reported as unknown.
Given an id that is not in the manifest, when resolveTextureKey runs, then it returns the fallback asset id.

preserve: Existing engine modules and the manifest loader behavior

technical_constraints: No node:fs import in the engine module, because the frontend bundles engine code
Reuse the AssetManifest, SceneDef and EffectSpec types
definition_of_done: Both functions are exported from game/src/engine/planPreload.ts
